main_body: two wooden crates with metal corner brackets
top_band: light tan and medium brown horizontal planks on rows 0-8 (large crate) and rows 8-14 (small crate)
evidence: Both crates clearly show foreshortened horizontal top plank surfaces (rows 0-8 on the left crate, 8-14 on the right crate) ending in a lighter front-edge row (row 8 and row 14), followed by a dark eave/recess shadow row (row 9 and row 15) and an inset vertical front face with a diagonal cross-brace (rows 9-19 and 15-23).

style.evidence: The crates use a 5-step brown wood ramp with dark brown material outlines and grey metal corner brackets; plank lines, recessed panel shadows, and diagonal braces avoid large flat fills, though per-plank grain is slightly simpler than the reference stall.
